content:
Tentative agenda ahead of the next meeting this Wednesday:

  • General updates. What's the state of #137 ?
  • LI showcased they could successfully fill in sorrys. Do we have anything we'd like to highlight as priority for them in any of ArkLib/VCV-io/iris-lean?
  • Computabe polynomials: discuss packaging things together now that we are starting to have several independent efforts finishing up (per last week's announcements)?
  • hax: would be great to gather some early feedback in case e.g. @Daniel Britten has had the chance to take a look (as he couldn't make the last meeting with Cryspen).

ArkLib regular meeting
Wednesday, September 10 2025-09-10T16:00:00+01:00
Google Meet joining info
Video call link: https://meet.google.com/qap-fjdx-qiy

Some updates ahead of the meeting (there may be more progress then):

  1. I think sorry's in Bluebell can be the next target for filling in. Not just sorry's but also appreciate a deep comparison with Bluebell's paper for any discrepancy. But for now, lemmas about probability theory are probably obvious places to start

  2. I'm exploring the list-based protocol spec definition (per Frantisek's suggestion) and it's been going pretty well. It reduces one layer of dependency without changing any semantics, and leads to easier definitions of sequential composition & other stuff. But this is somewhat blocked by the VCV-io refactor
